findings.text: Provides reservation of memory type tracking for a physical interval with exclusive end and a requested caching mode, optionally reporting the effective mode to the caller. Success is signaled with zero while invalid ranges, conflicting state, allocation failure and overlapping conflicts produce negative errors. When page attribute handling is disabled or the range is platform exempt the call succeeds without tracking.

Releases memory type tracking previously acquired for a physical interval. The call normalizes bounds, bypasses tracking when disabled or exempt, resets page state for RAM ranges, and removes an exactly matching interval entry otherwise, returning zero on success and negative errors for invalid or unmatched ranges.

Offers kernel and user single address translation invalidation. The kernel variant accounts the local event, delegates to the user variant, returns early when process isolation is off, and otherwise marks the current processor as needing propagation to other address spaces. The user variant forwards to a native single address flush selected by build configuration.

Entry for walking from a top level entry to the fourth level table for a virtual address. The index derives from shifting the address and masking to the per table count. The table base derives from the frame recorded in the top entry mapped through the direct map. When five level paging is disabled the walk reuses the supplied top pointer as the fourth level pointer.

Lookup entry that resolves a faulting virtual address to its instrumentation tracking record. It obtains the mapping level through address lookup, fails with no record when unmapped, aligns the address down to the level granularity, selects the list head for that aligned address, and scans under read side protection for an entry with identical aligned address.

Instrumentation page arming lifecycle. A record starts unarmed; arming warns when already armed yet continues, clears present state while saving prior presence, flushes the single kernel translation, then marks armed and returns the clear status. Clearing supports only two granularities and reports failure for missing mappings or unexpected levels. Save and restore are paired with restore assuming a prior clear.

Upper directory entry assessment. Emptiness means the raw value ignoring a documented hardware erratum mask equals zero. Presence means extracted flags contain the present indication. Leaf status follows the large page indication. Flag extraction masks raw with the complement of the frame mask, where the frame mask depends on leaf versus table form. Raw access has direct and delegated build variants.

Fourth level entry assessment mirrors the upper directory pattern with one simplification: no very large page form is supported so the frame mask is always the generic mask. Emptiness ignores the same erratum mask, presence checks the present indication in extracted flags, flags are raw masked by complement of frame mask, and raw access again has direct versus delegated variants.

Top level assessment and five level gating. Emptiness is forced false when five level paging is off and otherwise means raw value zero without erratum workaround. Flags are raw masked by the generic flags mask. Enablement is constant false on one 32 bit build and either a variable read or a processor feature query on 64 bit builds.

Middle directory value handling preserves the frame number while adjusting protection. Invalidation keeps the frame and drops present and protection none indications through the protection constructor. Frame extraction removes protection none encoding before masking and shifting. Construction shifts the page number, applies the same correction, masks to the directory page mask, and merges sanitized protection intersected with the supported mask only when present is requested, with debug builds warning on unsupported bits. Correction is zero on one build and all ones for nonzero nonpresent values on the inverted build.

Table entry accessors exist in paired native and virtualized forms with identical logical effect. Middle and leaf value constructors, value readers, table stores, atomic leaf stores and leaf clearing either use native helpers directly or dispatch through operation vectors with a fast path when virtualization is absent. Dispatch helpers adapt one and two argument calls to the operation table.

A single spin lock serializes non RAM interval tracking. Reservation holds it across conflict check and insertion and releases it on success and failure paths, freeing the candidate on failure. Release holds it across exact match removal. Per page RAM stamping shown here does not take this lock.

Two record layouts appear. The instrumentation fault record carries an aligned address, a boolean armed state, a reference count, saved prior presence, and list linkage for per address chaining. The memory type interval record carries inclusive start, exclusive end, and a caching mode. A transient range scan state carries a start frame and flags including a RAM indicator consumed by the walker.

Reservation normalizes both bounds through physical sanitization with exclusive end adjustment, rejects empty intervals, bypasses tracking with appropriate effective mode when disabled or platform exempt, folds a firmware type hint that demotes one requested mode unless the hint matches, branches to per page RAM handling versus interval allocation, and logs through conditional debug and info channels with readable mode names. One build provides a trivial always success insert.

RAM classification skips the legacy low region, walks system RAM ranges with callback state, and reports RAM only, mixed or none. RAM reservation rejects one protection mode, demotes strong uncached with a one time warning, verifies every page in the range is currently default cached else reports busy with the offending type, then stamps the requested mode; release resets every page to default. One build stores the mode in page flag bits updated with an atomic compare exchange loop, while the alternate build reads a sentinel and ignores stores.

Non RAM tracking uses an ordered interval store. Insertion first checks conflicts, adopts the consensus type for the new entry when reporting is allowed, then inserts. Conflict search succeeds with no overlap, requires uniform type across all overlaps, fails when types differ or when adjustment is forbidden with a mismatch, and reports busy on failure. Erasure scans overlaps for exactly equal bounds, removes and returns it, otherwise signals invalid. Alternate header builds provide trivial insert success and empty erase.

Instrumentation arming hazards. Double arming emits warnings but still proceeds to clear and mark armed, so callers must not rely on idempotence. Clearing fails when address translation yields no entry and when the level is neither the middle nor leaf size. Restore assumes a prior clear saved a value.

Reservation hazards. Empty or wrapped ranges after sanitization, mixed RAM and non RAM ranges, unmatched frees, and conflicting overlapping types all fail. RAM ranges fail busy if any page already carries a non default mode and fail invalid for one protection request. One uncached flavor is silently demoted. Allocation failure is possible for non RAM entries.

Translation and invalidation hazards. Top level emptiness always reports present when five level paging is disabled, so it cannot gate table release in that mode. Kernel single flush on isolated builds only marks cross address propagation for later handling rather than completing it synchronously. Middle frame masks differ between leaf and table forms, so flag extraction must use the matching mask.

Symbolic constants define the contract. Level identifiers separate leaf and middle granularities. Protection indications mark present, large page, and a hardware erratum mask excluded from emptiness tests. Masks separate frame from flags for generic, middle and upper levels plus a supported protection mask and a physical address mask. Caching modes form a small enumeration with distinct readable names and a fallback name for unknown values. Logging uses a module prefix and a debug enable flag.
